cli.description: meshanvil <command>. One way in, whoever is typing.

welcome.tagline: Local report viewer and operation runner.
welcome.demo: generate a demo subject and first report

list.help: the operations found, and what each one takes

schema.help: print the report, operation and CLI JSON contracts

status.help: print project state and next-action hints as JSON

reports.help: list reports or read one report as JSON

demo.help: generate a demo subject and write the first report

run.help: run one operation and write its report
run.set: a parameter of the operation; repeatable
run.from: declare the parent report instead of deriving it from the fingerprint
run.evidence: append this successful report as Logics task evidence (TASK:AC)

view.help: build the viewer over the reports and open it
view.serve: accepted for compatibility; serving is now the default
view.file: build a file:// snapshot instead of serving the live viewer
view.no_open: build it without opening a browser

runbook.help: scaffold a Logics runbook from one report chain

cli.help: show this help message and exit
cli.version_help: show program's version number and exit

init.help: make this directory a project and create its work directories

list.empty: no operation found. An operation is a script plus a <script>.op.json beside it.

run.source_is_read_only: {path} is a source. Operations never write to work/in/ -- copy it into work/out/ and run on the copy.
run.work_unavailable: {path} is not writable; fix it before running an operation
run.target_busy: another operation is already running on this source; wait for it to finish
run.no_report: the engine wrote no report after {seconds}s; job kept at {job}
run.no_heartbeat: no heartbeat for {seconds}s; the engine is still running
run.operation_failed: the operation ran and did not succeed; read the report
run.no_report_json: the engine wrote no report; the job file is kept for diagnosis

engine.not_found: {engine} not found. Set {variable} to its path, or install it -- see CONTRIBUTING.md.
engine.override_missing: {variable} points at {path}, which does not exist
engine.too_old: {engine} {found} is too old: {needed} or later is required by {reason}; set {variable} to another binary

freecad.reason: Optional; only needed to ingest a STEP source.

work.reason: Required for reports, outputs, and renders.

view.open_address: open the address below in a browser
view.port_busy: viewer port {port} is already in use by another process

bridge.evidence_failed: no Logics evidence was written because the operation failed
bridge.evidence_unavailable: Logics evidence was not written: logics-manager is unavailable
bridge.runbook_unavailable: Logics runbook was not created: logics-manager is unavailable

ui.reports_appear: Reports appear here once one has been written under work/ops/.
ui.report_shows: A report shows its input, what changed, what was not checked, and its renders.
ui.no_render_hint: Run it with rendering enabled, or open the file in Blender to look at the geometry.
ui.axes_moved: Axes moved: {axes}. Computed by the report writer, not by the operation.
ui.warning_codes_note: Warning codes, not sentences: an agent can act on a code.
ui.no_parent: No parent -- start of the chain.
ui.render_provenance: Written by the operation and listed in renders[]. The viewer renders nothing: it shows what the engine already produced.
ui.tile_hint: this one is the node tile
ui.version_drift: This report was produced by engine {mine}; others in this chain used {others}. Numbers from different engine versions are not comparable.
ui.note_placeholder: Why it mattered, what to try next
ui.note_read_only: No note. A page opened from the filesystem cannot write one.
ui.not_applied: Not yet applied by an operation.
ui.start_outliner: Run one command below; its report will become the first chain entry.
ui.start_intro: Meshanvil records operations instead of changing the source. Build a demonstration, or start a project of your own and run an operation on it.
ui.start_prepare: Then run an operation on your source:
ui.start_environment_note: This page only reads the last setup report; it does not run checks or install anything.
ui.start_doctor_missing: No setup report yet. Run this command to see the Blender binary and version that Meshanvil will use.
ui.start_ops_ready: work/ops exists and will hold operation reports.
ui.start_ops_missing: work/ops has not been created yet; it will appear with the first report.
ui.start_contributors_note: The pinned Logics tooling and its offline Mermaid support are for corpus work, not for running an operation.
ui.start_preview: A demonstration, or your first operation, will give this area its first geometry preview.
ui.run_busy: a command is already running; try again once it finishes
ui.splash_tpl_repair: Start a project of your own
ui.splash_recent_empty: This project holds no report yet. Run one of the commands beside this, then rebuild the page.
ui.splash_recent_found: {count} reports loaded from the current chain.
ui.splash_demo_note: No subject of your own yet? Either demonstration builds its own project and opens here.
ui.runbook_empty: No runbook matches the current filter.
ui.runbook_no_summary: Open the runbook to read its procedure.
ui.compare_note: Identical camera on both states. What the numbers understate, the wipe shows.
ui.no_comparison: This operation wrote no before/after pair. Comparison needs two renders shot with the same camera.
ui.artefact_note: The file the operation wrote. Pruning drops it and keeps the report; the report is the record, not the file.
ui.splash_project_note: {name} at {path}, resolved by {rule}. Every report, render and artefact of a run lands here.

clean_shells.summary: Drop every shell below a vertex threshold, pruning by size and never by rank.

drop_unseen.summary: Delete every object ray_visibility never saw, leaving the outer envelope.

list_shells.summary: Enumerate the shells of an object with their size and bounding box.

render_subject.summary: Render the subject from the standard views and record them, changing nothing.

make_character.summary: Add one modelling stage of the T-pose character to whatever the previous stage left.

make_hammer.summary: Add one modelling stage of the meshanvil hammer to whatever the previous stage left.

make_sportscar.summary: Add one modelling stage of the sports car to whatever the previous stage left.

make_vise.summary: Add one modelling stage of the bench vise to whatever the previous stage left.

ray_visibility.summary: Sort objects by visibility from outside, by firing parallel rays from a sphere.

recenter.summary: Centre the geometry on X and Y, sit it on z = 0, optionally at a scale.

scan_defects.summary: Sweep a scene for smeared patches and coincident duplicate objects.

voxel_remesh.summary: Join every mesh and remesh it at a voxel size, producing one closed solid.

import_step.summary: Read a STEP source in FreeCAD and tessellate it into an STL mesh.

apply_modifiers.summary: Bake every modifier into the mesh, so a Mirror is geometry before anything joins it.

solidify.summary: Give every open surface a wall, so the remesh that follows has a volume to work on.

import_mesh.summary: Read an OBJ, STL or PLY source into the chain, recording what came in.

reports.none_yet: no report yet: run an operation, or `meshanvil demo`
reports.malformed_report: the report could not be read: {reason}
